Wirtschaft am Schlössli

Seestrasse 50, Bottighofen, 8598, Switzerland
Cuisine:
Mediterranean Cuisine, French
Price:
€€€
Good for:
Outdoor dining Inspectors favorite
{{count}} people love this place
Christian Kuchler from Taverne zum Schäfli in Wilgoltingen is also behind this culinary hotspot here in nearby Bottighofen, in a lovely location by the marina. Under the direction of head chef Monika Huber (formerly sous-chef to Christian Kuchler), the food is ambitious. The menu is divided into "France", "Italy", "Iberian Peninsula" and "Classics". Your Mediterranean journey ranges from "rabbit roulade, raw ham, sage, courgette" to "scampi, fregola sarda, lemon, pepperoncini" and "Ibérico pork Alenttejana" to "tortelloni, tomato, burrata, Taggiasca olive". Accompanied by a well-curated wine list with a fine selection from Switzerland and Europe. Enjoy your meal inside in a relaxed bistro atmosphere or out on the gorgeous terrace on the shores of Lake Constance. Tip: Tapas are also served all day on a separate terrace – Lästermeile – on the marina promenade.
